status: DRAFT - NOT SIGNED - NO HISTORICAL EVALUATION PERMITTED
drafted: 2026-10-31 Cairo by Codex after PR #257 merged
hypothesis: An equal-weight BTC/ETH long-spot, matched-short-perpetual portfolio earns a positive return above cash after all four-fill costs because positive settled funding outweighs hedge drift, rebalancing and execution drag.

trial_budget.multiplicity: the equal-weight USDT basket is the only promotable primary; asset and USDC rows are diagnostics and cannot rescue it

portfolio.weight_rule: each asset is a separate sleeve; if either sleeve leaves its leverage band, rebalance the whole portfolio at the next causal observation to 50/50 sleeve equity and 3x futures leverage per sleeve, charging every close and reopen fill; weights otherwise drift
portfolio.hedge: long spot and short the same base-asset quantity
portfolio.rebalance: when observed futures leverage leaves the closed 2x..5x band, close and reopen both legs at the same causal observation; charge every fill

data.source: official Binance public archive at data.binance.vision; every zip verified against its sibling CHECKSUM

series.spot: spot/monthly/klines/<symbol>/1h through 2026-08, then spot/daily/klines/<symbol>/1h for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-27
series.funding: futures/um/monthly/fundingRate/<symbol> through 2026-08, then futures/um/daily/fundingRate/<symbol> for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-27

availability.spot_1h: bar is available only after close_time; replay uses it from the next millisecond
availability.mark_1h: bar is available only after close_time; replay uses it from the next millisecond
availability.funding: nominal fundingTime plus 300 seconds; no event is credited earlier

data.read_definition: read means deserialize a market-data row into the replay process; no archive containing a row on or after the seal is used, and no such row may be deserialized, logged or summarized
data.missing: no forward fill across a missing hourly spot/mark observation or funding event; affected interval is INCOMPLETE
data.timestamps: all timestamps are unique strictly increasing integer milliseconds; hourly bar close times must be within 1000 ms of their expected boundary; funding timestamps are not forced to an 8h grid because Binance intervals can vary, but duplicate, non-increasing, future or schema-invalid events refuse the run
data.holdout_access: nothing on or after the sealed development end is read until a separate signed holdout authorization

costs.funding: actual signed settled rate times held short quantity and the close price of the latest fully closed 1h mark bar whose close_time is strictly earlier than the nominal fundingTime; positive funding is received by the short

stress.cost_x1.5: fees and slippage x1.5; received funding divided by 1.5; paid funding x1.5
stress.cost_x2: fees and slippage x2; received funding divided by 2; paid funding x2
stress.funding_sign_reversal: funding sign reversed, report-only tail stress
stress.rebalance_latency_1h: rebalance at the following causal hourly observation

windows.rule: the two pre-walk-forward windows fit no parameter and cannot tune the frozen rules; every walk-forward split starts a fresh portfolio and no position, rebalance, funding event or lookback crosses a boundary
windows.usdc_comparison: report only on the common complete overlap; it cannot be extrapolated into earlier folds

metrics: liquidation count and minimum margin headroom

gates.data: zero unresolved accounting rows and zero silently filled gaps; a fold with an incomplete required series is INCOMPLETE
gates.activity: at least 300 settled funding events per primary asset and at least 30 days per reported fold
gates.fold_stability: positive cash-excess return in at least 4 of 5 USDT walk-forward folds
gates.combined: USDT primary annualized return exceeds the 6% hurdle and 95% moving-block-bootstrap LCB of daily cash-excess return is above zero
gates.cost_stress: cost_x1.5 cash-excess return above zero; cost_x2 above zero required for PAPER promotion
gates.risk: no liquidation, base maximum drawdown <= 15%, stress maximum drawdown <= 25%, and recovery <= 365 days
gates.concentration: neither BTC nor ETH contributes more than 75% of absolute net PnL
gates.promotion: all gates plus independent reproduction; a USDC diagnostic cannot rescue a failed USDT primary

bootstrap.input: chronologically concatenated daily arithmetic cash-excess returns from the five fresh-start walk-forward folds
bootstrap.combined_annualization: compound the concatenated daily portfolio returns in chronological order and annualize with 365.25 divided by the number of included calendar days

gate_values.liquidation: for each hourly interval, test the mark-kline high against the short sleeve liquidation proxy before using the close; equality or a breach is liquidation and fails the run; this conservative hourly-high proxy cannot resolve sub-hour path ordering

paper.future_canary: isolated default-OFF book, no more than 10% of PAPER capital, only after signed historical evidence and independent review

mainnet: forbidden; this candidate cannot authorize real funds
